summary: Transcript work rows keep the host's semantic tool kind (read, search, run, change, subagent, web, decision, todo, wait, message, schedule, terminal input, skill, eval) as data-tool-kind, with scoped targets: a run shows its readable command's first nonempty line before cwd, a search shows its term within its path, a delegation its task names. Orphan results stay unclassified. Row titles are plain text, and a finished call without output ends its row with ' · No output' in meta ink. The raw disclosure previews four output lines and offers Open inspector only when that preview is truncated. Recorded semantic results without text remain inspectable behind the existing raw input/output disclosure; skipped calls read Skipped without failure ink, and settled summaries count delivered messages.

compatibility.detail: No wire change. fractal-ui WorkKind renames edit to change and adds the semantic kinds above plus unknown; kindFor receives the native tool item as an optional second argument. ToolCall items and results accept optional view, metadata and skipped facts; WorkLogCall adds optional toolName, callId, input, mediaType and skipped; WorkLogTurn adds messagesSent. Hosts that return edit must return change. The tool preview's host action is now Open inspector, named 'Open inspector for <title>', and appears only for a truncated preview; the '+N lines' count is gone. fractal-web's conversation model accepts the same optional ToolCall view/skipped and ToolResult metadata/view facts, and its tool classifier returns change.
